decisions.chain_element: Render the genomic sequence into a structured multi-page DNA document

evidence.quote: Given a DNA sequence S of length N loaded from FASTA, we convert it into a DNA document D ( S ) .
We rasterize S as monospace-like text onto a fixed-resolution canvas, writing nucleotides row-by-row (left-to-right within each row, then top-to-bottom across rows).

decisions.rationale: R6: rendering sequence data into a structured textual document is serialize.

decisions.chain_element: Encode the patches with the SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end

decisions.chain_element: Aggregate pages with the multi-page fusion module Fθ

evidence.quote: Since a DNA sequence can span multiple pages, we aggregate { ˜ U [ p ] } P -1 p =0 into a fixed-length document representation:

We instantiate F θ as a multi-head self-attention module with one attention layer and 20 heads, followed by a mean reduction over the page dimension, yielding a compact token sequence invariant to the number of pages.

decisions.rationale: R3: the named multi-page fusion module is retained as one learned_module boundary.
decisions.uncertainty: The paper describes internal self-attention and mean reduction, but the chain element names the fusion module itself; those internals are not decomposed here.
